lede: The biggest item this week is at Ouray County's Planning Commission on August 19, where three public hearings include a full repeal of Section 16 of the county's land use regulations — the kind of wholesale code change that rewrites the ground rules for future development. Closer to home, SMART's board votes Wednesday on two resolutions restructuring the Gondola Advisory Committee and assigning professional services tied to the $5.2M/year gondola tax project, while San Miguel County's Planning Commission takes up an energy code update and subdivision mechanics on Thursday. Mushroom Fest runs through the weekend for anyone who needs a reminder that this valley still knows how to have a good time.
